units: mm, kg, N, Nm, kg m2 as marked

frames.offset_policy: No translation of old axes. Not a whole-arm eRob replacement.

vendor_envelope.unmodeled: Mating plugs, wires, retention, assembly tolerances

J7_insertion.direction: -Z relative to seated J7; slide upward into seat from below
J7_insertion.beyond_100: Entire OEM at Z<=-65 in pair frame, below yoke minZ=-38; separated

A01P_insertion.scope: Skirt sweep plus z/radial separation; all aligned translations toward seated; tolerance and complete threads excluded

q6_continuous.method: Y-plane separation invariant under rotation about +Y, plus axisymmetric rear pilot containment
q6_continuous.excluded: Unknown OEM output/internal fixed-versus-rotating partitions; all upstream links/J5/new J6 fixed bracket/head/cables. External interface compatibility only.

q7_continuous.method: Z-plane and annular separation invariant under +Z rotation
q7_continuous.excluded: True head and cable assembly, and OEM internal rotational partition. No end-effector full swept-volume approval.

rear_service_reservation.warning: A chosen keep-clear volume; cable bend radius, keyed insertion/latch access and actual mated plug tolerances NOT qualified. J6 rear (-Y) is unconstrained by this positive-Y candidate but next upstream bracket is unknown.

body_rows.source: catalog2g each; COM at headside bearing plane proxy, not supplier COM
ideal steel cylinder estimate; exact vendor mass/end geometry absent

mechanics.offset_origin: J7 OEM output plane at pair[0,55,35], not H01 front; TCP+200, headCOM+100

J6_OUTPUT8.conditions: Equal stiffness, compatible compression contact, no prying. Increments are not total/preload forces or strength acceptance.

J7_FIXED8.conditions: Equal stiffness, compatible compression contact, no prying. Increments are not total/preload forces or strength acceptance.

J7_OUTPUT8.conditions: Equal stiffness, compatible compression contact, no prying. Increments are not total/preload forces or strength acceptance.

HEAD4.conditions: Equal stiffness, compatible compression contact, no prying. Increments are not total/preload forces or strength acceptance.

neck_section.condition: Selected Y=15 neck section; M about J6 plus motor-COM geometric uncertainty used conservatively for this zero-pose geometry. Not fillet stress, ring bending, buckling or global lower bound.

main_disc_strip.scope: Selected cantilever strip between outer head screw and closest OEM screw; not guaranteed ring response or FEA.

skirt.condition: Only a projected-area indicator, not actual contact pressure. No interference stress, hoop stability, tolerance or fretting calculation; main bolt-to-bolt load path stays within Z0..8.

not_validated: Complete OEM thread engagement, screw lengths/PN, preload/friction
Local ring/neck/notch FEA, fatigue, shock, elasticity or fast stop
Bearing life and static moment limit
Zero-speed continuous motor thermal torque/brake emergency duty
Head geometry and real cable motion
